Region growing: the pre-neural baseline.zh: 区域生长：神经网络之前的基线方法

Before CNNs, segmentation started from a.zh: 在 CNN 出现之前，分割从一颗种子像素出发，在邻域颜色保持相似时向外生长。其规则只需四行代码：在 4-邻接邻域上做 BFS；若某像素与种子（或该区域的滑动均值）的 RGB 距离在阈值 $\tau$ 之内，就将其纳入。
Before CNNs, segmentation started from a.src:
Before CNNs, segmentation started from a seed pixel and grew
          outward while neighbours stayed similar in colour. The rule is
          four lines of code: BFS over 4-connected neighbours; include a
          pixel if its RGB distance to the seed (or the running mean of the
          region) is within a threshold $\tau$.

@@T0@@The pre-neural weakness.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@神经网络之前的弱点。@@T1@@
          在天空上放置一颗种子，缓慢调高 $\tau$。当 $\tau$ 较低时，你得到一块干净的天空掩码。当 $\tau$ 较高时，一旦建筑物的颜色足够相近，区域就会渗漏进去。这正是核心问题所在：「颜色相同」只是「物体相同」的一个脆弱代理。神经网络学会了在颜色无关紧要时忽略它（阴影下的草与阳光下的草依旧都是草），而在颜色确实重要时才予以关注。
@@T0@@The pre-neural weakness.@@T1@@\n.src: The pre-neural weakness. Drop a seed on the sky, raise $\tau$ slowly. At low $\tau$, you get a clean sky mask. At high $\tau$, the region leaks into buildings the moment their colour is similar enough. That's the core problem: "same colour" is a fragile proxy for "same object." A neural net learned to ignore colour when it doesn't matter (shaded vs sunlit grass is still grass) and to pay attention when it does.

@@T0@@Why resolution vs receptive field.zh:
@@T0@@为何分辨率与感受野是一对真实的矛盾。@@T1@@
          要把某个像素判定为 @@T2@@汽车@@T3@@，模型需要来自周围众多像素的上下文（大感受野、深层特征）。要把该像素@@T4@@恰好定位在汽车边缘@@T5@@上，模型又需要完整的输入分辨率。上述每一种架构都是一种特定的折衷方案：跳跃连接、空洞卷积、掩码查询。DeepLab（本页所用）采用的是空洞卷积 + 空洞空间金字塔池化。
@@T0@@Why resolution vs receptive field.src: Why resolution vs receptive field is a real tension. To identify a pixel as car the model needs context from many surrounding pixels (big receptive field, deep features). To place that pixel right at the car's edge the model needs full input resolution. Every architecture above is one particular truce: skip connections, dilation, mask queries. DeepLab (this page) uses dilated convolutions + atrous spatial pyramid pooling.

Why cross-entropy alone fails.zh: 为何仅用交叉熵会失效

Per-pixel cross-entropy is the obvious l.zh: 逐像素交叉熵是最直观的损失，但在大多数真实图像中，80% 的像素都是背景。一个始终预测「背景」的模型能拿到 80% 的准确率，却毫无用处。有三种损失可修正这种不平衡：
Per-pixel cross-entropy is the obvious l.src:
Per-pixel cross-entropy is the obvious loss, but on most real
          images 80% of pixels are background. A model that always predicts
          "background" gets 80% accuracy while being useless. Three losses
          fix the imbalance:

@@T0@@Dice loss@@T1@@ (Milletari et&nbsp.zh: @@T0@@Dice 损失@@T1@@（Milletari 等，2016）：最大化软 Dice 系数。分子与分母同步缩小，因此模型在稀有类别上仍能获得信号。
@@T0@@Dice loss@@T1@@ (Milletari et&nbsp.src: Dice loss (Milletari et al., 2016): maximize the soft Dice coefficient. Numerator and denominator shrink together, so the model still gets signal on rare classes.

@@T0@@IoU / Lovász@@T1@@: directly optim.zh: @@T0@@IoU / Lovász@@T1@@：直接优化你真正关心的指标。Lovász 使之可微。
@@T0@@IoU / Lovász@@T1@@: directly optim.src: IoU / Lovász: directly optimize the metric you care about. Lovász makes it differentiable.

@@T0@@Focal@@T1@@ (Lin et&nbsp;al., 2017.zh: @@T0@@Focal@@T1@@（Lin 等，2017）：对交叉熵重新赋权，使容易的像素贡献更少。这主要是一种检测技巧，但也被广泛借用到分割任务中。
@@T0@@Focal@@T1@@ (Lin et&nbsp;al., 2017.src: Focal (Lin et al., 2017): cross-entropy re-weighted so easy pixels contribute less. Mostly a detection trick, but widely borrowed for segmentation too.

A segmentation prediction is one decisio.zh: 一次分割预测就是逐像素的一次判定。规模至关重要：即便是一张很小的照片，也有数十万个像素。
A segmentation prediction is one decisio.src:
A segmentation prediction is one decision per pixel. Scale matters:
          even a small photo has hundreds of thousands of them.

Per-pixel predictions for this photo.zh: 本照片的逐像素预测数量

Every one has to get a class. A 99% accu.zh: 每一个像素都必须得到一个类别。一个 99% 准确率的模型仍会在数千个像素上出错——这通常表现为锯齿状的边界以及被漏掉的细长结构。
Every one has to get a class. A 99% accu.src:
Every one has to get a class. A 99% accurate model still gets
            thousands of pixels wrong—which usually shows up as jagged
            boundaries and missed thin structures.

Four things that still trip people up.zh: 仍然容易让人栽跟头的四件事
Four things that still trip people up.src: Four things that still trip people up

@@T0@@\"Pixel accuracy tells you if the.zh:
@@T0@@「像素准确率就能说明模型是否优秀。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              在一张以天空为主的照片上，那个总是预测背景的平凡模型反而获胜。务必在报告像素准确率的同时报告平均 IoU。
@@T0@@\"Pixel accuracy tells you if the.src:
"Pixel accuracy tells you if the model is good."
On a sky-heavy photo, the background-predicting trivial model wins. Report mean IoU alongside pixel accuracy, always.

@@T0@@\"A mask that's a superset is safe.zh:
@@T0@@「掩码只要覆盖得更多就更安全。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              一个覆盖了真值同时又多出部分的掩码，其 IoU = 真值 / 掩码，会随掩码增大而缩小。紧致者胜出；漫溢扩张者受到惩罚。
@@T0@@\"A mask that's a superset is safe.src:
"A mask that's a superset is safe."
A mask that covers the truth plus extra has IoU = truth / mask, which shrinks as the mask grows. Tight wins; sprawl is penalised.

@@T0@@\"Segmentation is classification,.zh:
@@T0@@「分割不过是做更多的分类而已。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              逐像素 argmax 会产生闪烁的、孤立的错误像素。真实架构会注入@@T3@@结构性@@T4@@先验：跳跃连接、空洞上下文、CRF、解码器查询。
@@T0@@\"Segmentation is classification,.src:
"Segmentation is classification, done more."
Per-pixel argmax would give flickery, isolated wrong pixels. Real architectures inject structural priors: skip connections, dilated context, CRFs, decoder queries.

@@T0@@\"IoU 0.9 looks perfect.\"@@T1@@@@.zh:
@@T0@@「IoU 0.9 看上去完美无缺。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              它仍可能漏掉一根横贯图像的 10 像素电话线——也许那正是你的自动驾驶系统所需的那一个像素。定性的失败案例复核不是可选项。
@@T0@@\"IoU 0.9 looks perfect.\"@@T1@@@@.src:
"IoU 0.9 looks perfect."
It can still miss a 10-pixel telephone wire threading across the image—maybe the one pixel your autopilot needs. Qualitative failure review is not optional.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n A.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          分割器是一个从像素到标签的函数。你如今已亲眼看到真实的 DeepLab 在你的照片上实时完成这一过程，亲手绘制了一个与之竞争的掩码，对照模型为其评分，并看到神经网络之前的区域生长方法以那些恰恰催生了现代架构的方式成功与失败。所有更新的方法（Mask R-CNN、SAM、SegFormer）都是同一任务，只是网络更大、解码器更聪明。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n A.src: Final takeaway. A segmenter is a function from pixels to labels. You've now watched a real DeepLab do this live on your photo, painted a competing mask yourself, graded it against the model, and seen a pre-neural region-grower succeed and fail in exactly the ways that motivated modern architectures. Everything newer (Mask R-CNN, SAM, SegFormer) is the same task with bigger networks and smarter decoders.

@@T0@@Semantic segmentation.@@T1@@ Each.zh: @@T0@@语义分割。@@T1@@ 每个像素获得一个@@T2@@类别@@T3@@。相邻的两辆车会成为一个「汽车」色块。这是本文重点讨论的标准任务。数据集：ADE20K、Cityscapes（19 类）、PASCAL VOC。
@@T0@@Semantic segmentation.@@T1@@ Each.src: Semantic segmentation. Each pixel gets a class. Two cars next to each other are one "car" blob. The standard task this article focuses on. Datasets: ADE20K, Cityscapes (19 classes), PASCAL VOC.

@@T0@@Instance segmentation.@@T1@@ Each.zh: @@T0@@实例分割。@@T1@@ 每个像素获得一个类别@@T2@@以及@@T3@@一个实例 ID。两辆车分别成为 car-1 与 car-2。Mask R-CNN 是经典做法：先检测边界框，再在每个框内进行分割。数据集：COCO、LVIS。
@@T0@@Instance segmentation.@@T1@@ Each.src: Instance segmentation. Each pixel gets a class and an instance ID. The two cars become car-1 and car-2. Mask R-CNN is the classical approach: detect bounding boxes, segment within each. Datasets: COCO, LVIS.

@@T0@@Panoptic segmentation.@@T1@@ Combi.zh: @@T0@@全景分割。@@T1@@ 将二者结合起来——「可数物」（如汽车、人）获得实例 ID；「背景质料」（不可数，如天空、道路）只获得类别。COCO-Panoptic 与 Cityscapes-Panoptic 数据集在 2018 年前后围绕这一范式统一了整个领域。
@@T0@@Panoptic segmentation.@@T1@@ Combi.src: Panoptic segmentation. Combines both — "things" (countable: cars, people) get instance IDs; "stuff" (uncountable: sky, road) gets a class only. The COCO-Panoptic and Cityscapes-Panoptic datasets unified the field around this around 2018.

The 2021+ trend has been to unify all th.zh: 2021 年以来的趋势是把三者统一到单一 Transformer-解码器架构之下：Mask2Former、Mask DINO、OneFormer。一个模型、一套权重，完成全部三种任务。
The 2021+ trend has been to unify all th.src: The 2021+ trend has been to unify all three under a single transformer-decoder architecture: Mask2Former, Mask DINO, OneFormer. One model, one set of weights, all three tasks.

SAM — the foundation model for segmentat.zh: SAM —— 分割领域的基础模型
SAM — the foundation model for segmentat.src: SAM — the foundation model for segmentation

Segment Anything (Kirillov et&nbsp;al.,.zh: Segment Anything（Kirillov 等，2023；SAM-2，2024）之于分割，正如 GPT-3 之于文本：在一个十亿掩码上预训练一个巨型模型，随后让它根据提示（点、框或文本）分割任意对象。架构：ViT 图像编码器 + 小型提示编码器 + 轻量掩码解码器。输出：零样本、高质量掩码，且延迟达到交互级。
Segment Anything (Kirillov et&nbsp;al.,.src: Segment Anything (Kirillov et al., 2023; SAM-2, 2024) is the segmentation analogue of GPT-3 for text: pretrain a huge model on a billion masks, then have it segment anything from a prompt (point, box, or text). Architecture: ViT image encoder + small prompt encoder + lightweight mask decoder. Output: zero-shot, high-quality masks at interactive latency.

@@T0@@Strengths.@@T1@@ Zero-shot on nove.zh: @@T0@@优势。@@T1@@ 对新奇对象具备零样本能力；可交互（点击一个点即可得到掩码）；到 2024 年已可用于生产环境。
@@T0@@Strengths.@@T1@@ Zero-shot on nove.src: Strengths. Zero-shot on novel objects; interactive (click a point and get a mask); production-ready in 2024.

@@T0@@Weaknesses.@@T1@@ No class labels.zh: @@T0@@不足。@@T1@@ 没有类别标签（SAM 只做分割，不做分类）；小物体上的细粒度边界仍不完美；若需要语义标签，还需在其上叠加一个独立的分类器。
@@T0@@Weaknesses.@@T1@@ No class labels.src: Weaknesses. No class labels (SAM segments, doesn't classify); fine-grained boundaries on small objects still imperfect; needs a separate classifier on top for semantic labels.

@@T0@@SAM-2 (2024).@@T1@@ Adds video sup.zh: @@T0@@SAM-2（2024）。@@T1@@ 增加视频支持——借助记忆在帧间传播掩码。
@@T0@@SAM-2 (2024).@@T1@@ Adds video sup.src: SAM-2 (2024). Adds video support — propagate masks across frames with memory.

The right mental model: SAM is the high-.zh: 正确的心智模型是：SAM 是高召回率的「找出每一个物体」工具；你把它与分类器（CLIP、Grounding-DINO）组合，即可构成「找出类别 X 的每一个物体」的流水线。
The right mental model: SAM is the high-.src: The right mental model: SAM is the high-recall "find every object" tool; you compose it with a classifier (CLIP, Grounding-DINO) for "find every object of class X" pipelines.

@@T0@@Pixel-wise cross-entropy.@@T1@@ Th.zh: @@T0@@逐像素交叉熵。@@T1@@ 默认选择。速度快、易于理解，在各类别大致均衡时表现良好。
@@T0@@Pixel-wise cross-entropy.@@T1@@ Th.src: Pixel-wise cross-entropy. The default. Fast, well-understood, works well when classes are roughly balanced.

@@T0@@Weighted cross-entropy.@@T1@@ Rewe.zh: @@T0@@加权交叉熵。@@T1@@ 对稀有类别重新赋权。对于病灶可能仅占 1% 像素的医学分割尤为重要。
@@T0@@Weighted cross-entropy.@@T1@@ Rewe.src: Weighted cross-entropy. Reweight rare classes. Important for medical segmentation where the lesion might be 1% of pixels.

@@T0@@Dice loss.@@T1@@ $1 - 2|A \\cap B|.zh: @@T0@@Dice 损失。@@T1@@ $1 - 2|A \cap B| / (|A| + |B|)$。直接优化重叠程度；对类别不平衡极为有效。大多数医学分割论文使用 Dice 或 Dice + CE。
@@T0@@Dice loss.@@T1@@ $1 - 2|A \\cap B|.src: Dice loss. $1 - 2|A \cap B| / (|A| + |B|)$. Directly optimises overlap; very effective for imbalanced classes. Most medical segmentation papers use Dice or Dice + CE.

@@T0@@Boundary loss.@@T1@@ Penalises err.src: Boundary loss. Penalises errors near class boundaries more — encourages sharp, accurate edges.

meta.title: 图像分割：使用真实的语义分割模型
meta.tagline: 上传一张照片，运行真实的 DeepLab 模型，并用它为自己的掩码评分
meta.summary: 一个预训练的 DeepLab v3+（Pascal VOC，21 类）在你提供的任意照片上于浏览器中实时运行。亲手绘制掩码，观察平均 IoU 与逐类 IoU 相对真实模型输出的变化——或运行经典的区域生长方法，看它在何处失效。
highlights: 通过 TensorFlow.js 在浏览器内加载真实的 DeepLab v3+（Pascal VOC）——在真实照片上生成真实的语义掩码。
亲手绘制掩码，观察平均 IoU、像素准确率与逐类 IoU 逐步逼近真实模型的输出。
BFS 区域生长作为神经网络之前的基线供你对比：调节颜色阈值，看它成功或渗漏。
可上传任意 JPEG/PNG、抓取摄像头画面，或从六张素材照片中任选一张。
